context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 44 verified chat and AI features. Key findings: 1) AI Chat (FloatingBubbles) works - shows BRUNO IA with action buttons and card suggestions. 2) AI attachment button (paperclip) present. 3) Floating Chat Bubble opens popup with 'Mensajes' header and chat list. 4) Floating Chat Window has attach button, input, and mic button. 5) Chat Page (/chat) renders chat list, clicking opens conversation. 6) ChatAttachmentMenu shows 6 options in Messenger-style drawer: Camara, Galeria, Video, Documento, Tarjeta, Sticker. 7) Backend upload/chat-file returns url, filename, type. 8) Backend AI chat returns response and session_id. Minor issue: AI chat session test failed due to NoneType error when cards_context is None.
